class.name: Store
class.brief_description: Content the player buys once and keeps, on Steam, the App Store and Google Play.

method.name: get_price
method.description: The item's price as the store shows it to this player, in their currency ([code]"£4.99"[/code]), or an empty string when it isn't known yet or the store doesn't say. Steam doesn't tell games a DLC's price: its store page, which [method purchase] opens, shows it.

method.name: is_available
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] where there's a store to buy from: Steam is running, or the platform has its store, or the game runs from the editor.

method.name: owns
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the player owns the item [param id]. On the App Store and Google Play, what the player owns arrives shortly after the game starts; [signal ownership_changed] fires for each item as it does.

method.name: purchase
method.description: Asks the store to sell the player the item [param id], and returns a [Signal] to await. Its result is a [Dictionary] with [code]ok[/code], and on failure [code]error[/code] and [code]message[/code]. [code]error[/code] is [code]"cancelled"[/code] when the player changed their mind, [code]"pending"[/code] when the purchase goes on outside the game (Ask to Buy, a slow payment, or Steam without its overlay, where the item's page opens in Steam) and [signal ownership_changed] fires if it completes, [code]"unavailable"[/code] when there's no store or the item isn't on it, and [code]"failed"[/code] otherwise. Buying an item the player already owns succeeds at once. On Steam, the DLC's store page opens in the overlay, and the result comes once the player closes it.

method.name: restore
method.description: Asks the store again what the player owns, and returns a [Signal] to await, with the same result as [method purchase]. On the App Store, games selling items must have a [b]Restore Purchases[/b] button that calls this; elsewhere it's rarely needed, since Store always loads what the player owns.

signal.name: ownership_changed
signal.description: Emitted when the player comes to own the item [param id] (a purchase, here or on another device, or what they own arriving from the store), or no longer does (a refund). Check [method owns].
